_about: dimethyl-carbonate (1) + glycerol (2): the two liquids in equilibrium measured in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive's records (bulk file ThermoML.v2020-09-30.tgz), by validation/python/two_liquid_survey.py --classes (proposal 0019, step 2). Rows: T in K, P in kPa (null where the record gives none), mole fraction of component 1 in liquid I and in liquid II, index of the record in records.

records.citation: H. Wang, P. Lu, Liquid-Liquid Equilibria for the System Dimethyl Carbonate +  Methanol + Glycerol in the Temperature Range of (303.15 to 333.15) K, J. Chem. Eng. Data 57 (2012) 582-589
